# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I see a green light, display 0, and three wires ordered yellow, red, blue. I will tell both teammates; Mute can use the manual to determine instructions and communicate any needed visual code by gesture, while Blind hears the bomb state directly.

``` 
speak(text="Bomb view: DISPLAY 0. LIGHT green. WIRES in order: 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
wait()
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light has changed from green to blue. Mute has visually signalled ☝ to me; since Blind cannot see it, I will relay that exact signal in words and include the updated bomb state.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Update: LIGHT is blue; display remains 0; wires remain 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute gestured: ☝.")
speak(to="mute", text="I relayed your ☝ gesture to Blind. Current light is blue; display 0; wires yellow, red, blue.")
wait()
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light is now yellow, while the display and wire order are unchanged. Mute again signals ☝, which I interpret as the communicated number one and will relay to Blind along with the visible state.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light yellow; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute again gestured number one (☝).")
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: light yellow; display 0; wires unchanged: yellow, red, blue. I relayed your number-one gesture to Blind.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has progressed to red, with display 0 and the wire order unchanged. No new gesture arrived from Mute this turn. Blind needs the current visual state to apply any manual-derived rule.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light red; wires in order 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. No new Mute gesture this turn.")
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light red; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light is now purple; the display remains 0 and the wires remain yellow, red, blue in positions 1–3. I will provide this update to both teammates.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light purple; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light purple; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [☝ 🫵]

The visible state is now orange, with display 0 and wires still yellow, red, blue. Blind sent me two gesture symbols: an upward index finger followed by a pointing-at-you hand. Mute cannot receive a gesture addressed only to me, so I will describe it verbally and update both teammates.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light orange; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Blind privately gestured an upward index finger, then a hand pointing at you.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light orange; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. I received your two-sign gesture and told Mute its description.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🫵 ☝]

The light is now white; display 0 and wire order remain yellow, red, blue. Mute again sent the single raised-index gesture. Blind sent a pointing-at-you gesture followed by a raised-index gesture. I will relay these descriptions to each party and report the current state.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light white; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Blind privately gestured: a hand pointing at you, followed by a raised index finger.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light white; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute privately gestured a single raised index finger.")
wait()
```

The light has returned to green, completing the observed seven-colour cycle. Display remains 0 and the wires remain ordered yellow, red, blue. There are no new gestures to relay.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light green; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light green; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
wait()
```

WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

(empty)

The light is blue again, confirming the repeating sequence green, blue, yellow, red, purple, orange, white. The display remains 0 and the wire order remains yellow, red, blue. I will send the update and explicitly ask Mute to communicate any manual-derived action instruction in a form Blind can follow.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current view: display 0; light blue; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Please send any manual-derived instruction for Blind using your established gesture code; I will relay it.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current view: display 0; light blue; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. The seven-light sequence is repeating.")
wait()
```

LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light is yellow again, with display 0 and wire order unchanged. Mute has repeated the single ☝ gesture. No explicit shared meaning for it has been established, so I will relay it as the exact symbol rather than assume it means “cut wire 1.”

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light yellow; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute again sent the exact single gesture ☝; its intended meaning has not been stated aloud.")
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light yellow; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. I relayed your exact ☝ gesture to Blind without assuming its meaning.")
wait()
```

DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [☝ ✌ 🖖]

The light is red; display 0 and wire order remain yellow, red, blue. Blind sent the three-symbol sequence ☝ ✌ 🖖 privately. I will relay it exactly to Mute, without assigning an unconfirmed meaning, and report the current state to Blind.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light red; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Blind privately gestured the exact sequence: ☝ ✌ 🖖.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light red; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. I relayed your exact gesture sequence ☝ ✌ 🖖 to Mute.")
wait()
```

DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🫵 ☝]

The light is purple, with display 0 and wires still ordered yellow, red, blue. Blind again sent 🫵 ☝, apparently directing attention to Mute and the previously repeated ☝ signal. I will relay the exact sequence to Mute and continue reporting the visible state.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current bomb view: display 0; light purple; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Blind again privately gestured the exact sequence 🫵 ☝.")
speak(to="blind", text="Current visible state: display 0; light purple; wires 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. I relayed your exact 🫵 ☝ sequence to Mute.")

```
